method.scope: Reflect the independently checked rectangular lap about the centre support, along the longitudinal axis only. Retain the multilayer cross-section, transverse partner offset, uniform web links and zero torsion.
method.actions: Use the declared U1 and U2 equal-span UDLs. Recompute signed rows from three-moment statics. In span two the positive moment interval is 5000 to 8000 mm, with the stationary maximum at 6500 mm.
method.transfer: Order the three supplied overlap stations by increasing coordinate. Transfer toward decreasing x. Upstream denotes the outer-right original piece and downstream the partner reaching the left support. Test each layout in the overlap without double credit.
method.outputs: Use the checked paths in report, elevation, sections and BBS. Withhold the checked drawing and BBS on all FAIL and HOLD controls.
